query: SELECT b.id, b.name, bt.name as businessType, sc.name as sportCategory, b.city, b.region FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN businessTypes bt ON b.businessTypeId = bt.id LEFT JOIN sportCategories sc ON b.sportCategoryId = sc.id WHERE b.id >= 53 ORDER BY b.id
